lines.en: Thank you for coming prior to your army's departure.  You certainly are the trusting type...
lines.zh: 感谢你能在自己军队开拨之前过来见我。 你很容易信任别人啊……
lines.name: 莱桑德

lines.en: Wha... Lysander?!  General Lysander? Of the Imperial Army?
lines.zh: 什……莱森德？！ 莱森德将军？帝国军部的那位？

lines.en: Yes. I know your name from the Academy.  Seems we never crossed paths before.
lines.zh: 正是。我在学院时听过你的名字。 好像之前我们都没碰过面。
lines.name: 莱桑德

lines.en: I just thought you would be older...
lines.zh: 我只是以为你年纪会大一点儿……

lines.en: ...How did you know where to find me?
All that matters now is that I come to you with a warning.  News is already spreading... Empress Florina was murdered.
lines.zh: 重点是我给你带来了一个警告。 消息已经传开了……芙洛里娜女皇是被谋杀的。
lines.name: 莱桑德

lines.en: War is imminent.  The Empress's death has opened old wounds, sparked old rivalries.  The two strongest Dukes, Lothair and Terenor, have mobilized their armies.  It's civil war, and it's just a matter of time.
lines.zh: 战争风雨欲来。 女皇之死揭开了旧日的伤疤，往昔的恩怨也随之复发。 两位最强大的公爵，洛泰尔和特瑞诺，已经在动员他们的军队了。 内战肯定会打，只是时间问题罢了。
lines.name: 莱桑德

lines.en: Lysander, there's got to be more to this... and you know who.
lines.zh: 莱森德，我们不妨把话讲得透一点……你知道实际上是谁。

lines.en: Careful what you say, Protagonist.  The Prime Minister is very popular among the people.  He has surrounded himself with powerful allies...
lines.zh: Protagonist，当心祸从口出。 首相人气很高。 周边又有强大的盟友拱卫……
lines.name: 莱桑德

lines.en: Then you believe he is responsible for the murder?  Come on, just admit it!  He's been obsessed with becoming Emperor for so long.  He would do anything...
lines.zh: 所以你确实相信谋杀是他做的？ 拜托，利落地承认吧！ 他心心念念要做皇帝都这么久了。 他会不惜一切……

lines.en: You must keep your voice down.
lines.name: 莱桑德

lines.en: There are those among us in the Imperial Army who think as you do.  Do not act rashly. Casamir will make a mistake eventually.  For now, you should stay with the Temple.  When I have collected enough evidence to expose Casamir, I will find you.
lines.zh: 我们帝国军队中也有想法跟你一样的人。 不要轻举妄动。卡萨米尔迟早会犯错的。 眼下，你应当和圣殿的人待在一起。 在收集到足够的证据来揭露卡萨米尔后，我会找到你的。
lines.name: 莱桑德

lines.en: Until then, I trust you will keep this meeting to yourself?
lines.zh: 在那之前，我相信你会把我们这次的会面深埋心底了？
lines.name: 莱桑德
